# libyay (vendored)

`yay.js` is `js/libyay/yay.js` from `github.com/kriskowal/yay`, unchanged, at
`f0ba25822b06d7c195b7f224ae8f76df1e3f96ff` (libyay 1.1.0). Author Kris Kowal;
licence Apache-2.0, as stated in that package's `package.json`. It is the
parser only. The garden's writer and its Yaydown and SHON handling are in
`src/yay.js` and `src/shon.js`. Do not edit this file; replace it from
upstream and record the new commit here and in `upstream/port-log.yay`.
